title: Save race conversions whole and make every conversion one-way
message:
Save race conversions whole and make every conversion one-way

A descend form conversion saved before complete_quest() recorded the
quest as done and set the next stage, so a restart before the next save
kept the new race and the rewards but reopened the quest, which the
preflight then refused to finish. Every race reward now saves once the
quest history and next stage are recorded, before a follower's load
trigger can run; the Lich and Vampire rewards had no such save at all.

The already-transformed check ran only when the destination was a
descend form, so a Wight could still take a Lich or Vampire reward, the
legacy Lich quest, or the Lich rite. The race reward preflight, the
legacy quest, and the rite now all refuse a character whose real race
is already transformation-only.

title: Keep a character in the world when its link drops at a prompt
message:
Keep a character in the world when its link drops at a prompt

close_socket() freed the character of any descriptor outside
IS_PLAYING(). The first-quit survey, mail and board composition, and
the house and board editors all hold a character that is still in the
world in such states, so a link lost there freed a character still on
character_list: the server then spun at full CPU or crashed in
perform_dupe_check() at the next login. A character still on the list
now goes linkdead and saves like any other, and logging back in
reconnects to it.

title: Retire the finished Duris races plan
message:
Retire the finished Duris races plan

All seventeen races are in, with their help, tests, and documentation,
and the live check passed: a bought Thri-Kreen through the terminal, a
bought Centaur through the web catalog, a premade Kobold, later-level
grants at levels 6 and 11, and reconnects. The descend forms wait only
for their quests, which the race reference records. The login repair
plan notes the race checks it would let go.

title: Keep the acquisition list tight in the race reference
message:
Keep the acquisition list tight in the race reference

The descend form class table sat inside a list item, which made the
formatter loosen the whole list. It now follows the list.

title: Document the Duris races
message:
Document the Duris races

The player race reference lists the seventeen races with their feats,
calibration scores, trait prices, and descend form acquisition, answers
the Thri-Kreen open decisions, records how the Duris data was
converted, and corrects the claim that tiers differ only by unlock cost:
level_exp() charges 2, 7, and 10 times the experience per tier.

The mechanics reference records the psionic resistance and cold
immunity feat checks and the rebuilt epic damage reduction, the limb
document records Four Arms on Thri-Kreen, and the race guide's IDs,
bounds, hard lock, and quest conversion facts are brought current.

title: Add help for the Duris races
message:
Add help for the Duris races

One component holds a RACE topic for each of the seventeen races, with
stats, tier, unlock, feats by level, and anatomy notes, and adds
Thri-Kreen to EPIC-RACES. The Minotaur topic replaces the retired
Dragonlance minotaur entry that already owned its keywords. A psionic
resistance topic joins the racial innate help.

The development help database took the same rows, and help.hlp is its
exact projection.

title: Add the five Duris descend forms
message:
Add the five Duris descend forms

Death Knight, Wight, Revenant, Shadow Beast, and Phantom take the
quest-only IDs 55 to 59. Each carries its own kit on a shared chassis
of armor skin, hardiness, toughness, fast healing, and three ranks of
epic damage reduction, takes ten times the experience, and counts as
undead.

The forms join Lich and Vampire as transformation-only races, so no
unlock, purchase, or creation path can select them. A standard quest
race reward converts a level 30 character with levels in one of the
form's classes, refuses anyone already transformed, respecs to the
form's class, and saves after the final experience and alignment.
QEDIT and the world validator accept the form IDs; no quest awards one
yet.

title: Add the twelve Duris creation races
message:
Add the twelve Duris creation races

Centaur, Githzerai, Firbolg, Githyanki, Kobold, Drider, Thri-Kreen,
Minotaur, Kuo Toa, Orog, Harpy, and Stormkin join the registry as IDs
152 to 163 with the stats, sizes, alignments, languages, attacks, lost
slots, and feat grants the plan settled. Each is parsed by name and by
its display name, has a creation help topic and a web media key, takes
its tier's experience multiplier, and counts in its family predicate.

Racial level feats now follow the real race, so a disguise or wild
shape at a level-up cannot trade away a later grant. Protocol v1 lists
every race on one page, so its race summaries are cut to 140
characters to keep the full catalog of 45 inside the payload budget.

title: Share the racial mechanics the Duris races need
message:
Share the racial mechanics the Duris races need

Rename the leonine frame feat to tauric frame, since Centaur and Drider
will hold it too. Add a psionic resistance feat that Trelux now holds,
and let the mental damage case and the Lich cold immunity case read their
feats beside the race checks that saved characters still rely on.

Race grants of epic damage reduction now build the DR entry that only
study used to build. That entry was never saved, because its spell is 0
and the save skips it as a duplicate, so loading rebuilds it from the
feat. One predicate now names the transformation-only races, and
respec_engine() accepts a NULL argument for any race.
